C0411.title: Evilginx2 2.0 Released: Reverse-Proxy Phishing Framework Can Bypass 2FA
C0411.summary: In July 2018, Kuba Gretzky released Evilginx2 2.0 on GitHub. The open-source tool operates as a reverse proxy between victims and legitimate login services, capturing credentials, authentication tokens, and session cookies to bypass 2FA in non-phishing-resistant MFA scenarios; MITRE ATT&CK later cataloged evilginx2 as an AiTM attack framework tool.
